canonical relation distinct from compiled aggregate

properties.name: P2 HSWM 계보적 시간론

architectural_implications: valid observed and commit time separation
versioned H and W lineage
supersession and scoped tombstone
forbidden_reductions: raw private payload must persist forever

properties.name: P3 HSWM 기억–진리 분리

preserve contradiction and uncertainty
scope every adopted judgment
forbidden_reductions: one scalar combines evidence reward and authority

properties.name: P4 HSWM 오류 가능성과 모순의 생산성
